args.sql:
SELECT 
    a.artregistry,
    a.artname,
    a.mattype,
    s.lightsensitivity,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.lightsensitivity = 'High' AND MAX(lr.lightlux) > 50 THEN 'Over Exposure'
        WHEN s.lightsensitivity = 'High' AND MAX(lr.lightlux) <= 50 THEN 'Within Limits'
        WHEN s.lightsensitivity = 'Medium' AND MAX(lr.lightlux) > 200 THEN 'Over Exposure'
        WHEN s.lightsensitivity = 'Medium' AND MAX(lr.lightlux) <= 200 THEN 'Within Limits'
        WHEN s.lightsensitivity != 'High' AND s.lightsensitivity != 'Medium' AND MAX(lr.lightlux) > 300 THEN 'Over Exposure'
        ELSE 'Within Limits'
    END as current_status
FROM artifactscore a
JOIN sensitivitydata s ON a.artregistry = s.artref
JOIN usagerecords ur ON a.artregistry = ur.artrefused
JOIN showcases sc ON ur.showcaserefused = sc.showcasereg
JOIN environmentalreadingscore er ON sc.showcasereg = er.showcaseref
JOIN lightandradiationreadings lr ON er.envreadregistry = lr.envreadref
WHERE s.lightsensitivity IN ('High', 'Medium')
GROUP BY a.artregistry, a.artname, a.mattype, s.lightsensitivity
ORDER BY a.artregistry;
